newsitem.title: MEXICO: Gruma to issue 20 million new shares.
newsitem.headline: Gruma to issue 20 million new shares.

text.p: Grupo Maseca, a holding company for firms that make and sell corn flour and tortillas, approved subscription rights for current shareholders to a new issue of 20 million B series shares, the company reported on Wednesday.

Shareholders will be able to subscribe up to nine million shares at first, and the remainder at a later stage, Gruma said in a report to the Mexican Stock Exchange. The move was approved at a shareholders' assembly held on Monday.
The company gave no details of dates or the ratio of how many new shares can be bought for each share held.

Gruma did say, however, that the assembly approved the sale of up to three million million shares to company executives, if they were not subscribed by shareholders. Any shares then remaining would be offered to the investor public in Mexico and abroad.
